typography.setup: Add to Google Fonts import in index.css or index.html

rules.h1: font-serif text-5xl md:text-7xl font-bold tracking-tighter text-[#FAEDE3]
rules.h2: font-serif text-4xl md:text-5xl font-semibold tracking-tight text-[#FAEDE3]
rules.h3: font-serif text-2xl md:text-3xl font-medium tracking-tight text-[#FAEDE3]
rules.overline: font-sans text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.2em] text-[#D4A373] font-bold

visual_enhancers.shadows: Use soft ambient shadows tinted with brown, e.g., shadow-[0_8px_32px_rgba(33,28,24,0.4)]
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid #332A24 for cards, border-[#D4A373]/30 on hover
visual_enhancers.radius: rounded-2xl for cards, rounded-full for primary buttons
visual_enhancers.textures: Consider a very subtle noise overlay over the background for an organic coffee-shop feel. NO transparent backgrounds for headers without glassmorphism blur.

buttons.primary: rounded-full bg-[#D4A373] text-[#161412] hover:bg-[#E5B887] px-8 py-3 font-semibold transition-transform hover:scale-105
buttons.secondary: rounded-full border border-[#332A24] bg-transparent text-[#FAEDE3] hover:border-[#D4A373] px-8 py-3 transition-colors

cards.menu_item: bg-[#211C18] border border-[#332A24] rounded-2xl p-4 transition-transform duration-300 hover:-translate-y-2 hover:border-[#D4A373]/50 hover:shadow-[0_12px_40px_rgba(212,163,115,0.15)] overflow-hidden

header.style: bg-[#161412]/80 backdrop-blur-2xl border-b border-[#332A24] sticky top-0 z-50 transition-colors

layouts.hero: Min-height 90vh, generous padding (py-32), massive serif typography. Asymmetric layout: text dominating the left, high-quality image on the right.
layouts.menu_grid: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-8 p-8
layouts.features_bento: Asymmetric bento grid mixing col-span-1 and col-span-2 for 30-min delivery stats and promises
layouts.spacing: Use p-8, p-12, py-24 for section spacing. Never cramp content. Add extra padding inside containers with borders to prevent text collision.

motion.hover: Scale up images slightly inside overflow-hidden cards. Lift cards. Change border colors.
motion.entrance: Staggered fade-up for menu items using framer-motion.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text contrast meets WCAG AA standards. Focus states should use focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#D4A373] focus:outline-none.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attribute. Format: kebab-case, role-based.

image_urls.description: Steaming dark coffee being poured, premium feel
White ceramic cup on wooden table
Black coffee / Americano in white cup

instructions_to_main_agent: Use Playfair Display for all headings (h1, h2, h3). Import it from Google Fonts.
The primary background must be #161412. Avoid default white or light gray.
Use the provided image_urls for the hero section and menu items. Do NOT use placeholder text for images.
Implement the shopping cart as a glassmorphic right-side drawer (use Shadcn Sheet component customized).
Implement smooth scrolling using framer-motion or simple CSS smooth scroll.
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes for testing.
Admin dashboard should share the same theme but use a tighter grid for data density.
Do NOT use HTML <select> or <input type='date'>. Use Shadcn components.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts. Use asymmetrical or balanced left-aligned layouts.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters for floating navs and cart drawers.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: `transition: all`.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add `.App { text-align: center; }`.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
Components MUST use named exports. Pages MUST use default exports.
